-- Create schema for security objects first
CREATE SCHEMA Security;
GO

-- Create the security predicate function
CREATE FUNCTION Security.fn_security_predicate(@Region NVARCHAR(50))
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
RETURN (
    SELECT 1 AS fn_security_result
    WHERE @Region = USER_NAME() OR USER_NAME() = 'dbo' 
);
GO
-- Create the security policy to filter DimCustomer by Region
CREATE SECURITY POLICY CustomerSecurityPolicy
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.fn_security_predicate(Region) 
ON dbo.DimCustomer
WITH (STATE = ON);
GO
